name: ethereal_elk_fetches_one_of_two
notes: Printed: 'When this creature enters, you may search your library and/or graveyard for a card named Vivien, Nature's Avenger, reveal it, and put it into your hand. If you search your library this way, shuffle.' One card in all: with a copy in the library AND one in the graveyard, searching both zones (option 0) puts exactly one into the hand: the graveyard copy, picked by name, so the zone is pinned too. Kills the search-count+1 mutant G3 left alive (M20 round 2, 2026-11-06).
